odir_exclusion.reason: OIA-ODIR is the same5000-patient source, not independent. Official creator description uses patient diabetes/hypertension and broad other abnormalities. Mirrors, new crops and previously exposed ODIR final cohorts cannot provide fresh confirmation. Creator repository read; challenge page403.

options.access: No PhysioNet entitlement verified; no restricted files downloaded. Do not upload restricted data to Kaggle without the applicable license/security permission.
options.labels: Native DR, AMD, myopic fundus, hypertensive retinopathy and other retinal findings; no documented cataract target. Increased cup-disc is not glaucoma. Other is not the ODIR residual taxonomy; normal anatomy is not all-eight N.
options.license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License1.5.0 and DUA; credentialing and CITI training required. Not an unrestricted redistribution license.
options.limitations: Version1.0.2 explicitly reviews eye laterality; use this version, not an older mirror. Actual column spelling must be checked against the downloaded version.
options.overlap: Separate Brazilian acquisition described, unlike Chinese ODIR; actual patient/image non-overlap not established. Related BRSET/mBRSET project links do not establish independent cohorts.
options.pairing: patient_id and exam_eye (1 right,2 left); one paired exam described. Actual complete-pair count unknown; image total is less than twice patient total.
options.recommended_use: First partial-label feasibility candidate after access and blinded endpoint review; not full eight-label confirmation.
options.verified_documentation: Public official release, data dictionary, release notes and license read directly.

options.access: Public Figshare release documented; actual download not attempted. No entitlement or file integrity claimed.
options.labels: Glaucoma endpoint only. Suspects are indeterminate, not negative; healthy for glaucoma does not establish N or absence of seven other ODIR labels.
options.license: Author institution records dataset GPL3.0+; do not substitute the article license. Confirm exact release terms before use/distribution.
options.overlap: Spanish clinical collection described in the primary article; no content-level overlap audit with ODIR performed.

options.recommended_use: Possible small paired-eye G-only transport study; not all-eight confirmation.
options.verified_documentation: Author-institution dataset record read directly; primary article indexed text confirms244 patients,488 eyes and identifiers. Direct Nature/PMC/Figshare opens were blocked or challenged; actual files not verified.

options.access: Challenge-hosted release; public page blocked in this review. Registration/terms and archive version remain unverified; do not replace with an unverified mirror.

options.license: Dataset descriptor explicitly states CC-BY4.0; verify downloaded release and attribution requirements.
options.overlap: Original Nanded,India acquisition described; byte/content checks against ODIR remain pending.
options.pairing: Descriptor defines an image ID; no verified patient/laterality linkage for the public release. Do not infer pairs from consecutive image numbers.
options.recommended_use: Possible separately labeled image-level partial study only if access/labels verified; unsuitable for the fixed paired-patient primary endpoint without curator-supplied linkage.
options.verified_documentation: Original dataset descriptor read directly; challenge download page403.
options.version: Original2021 release; exact downloadable archive version pending
